subject.title: fix(google): bound OAuth response reads to prevent OOM

question: Should this combined PR be the landing vehicle for the Google OAuth bounded-read hardening, or should maintainers prefer the focused sibling PRs with their existing tests?
rationale: The code change is small and appears correct, but multiple open PRs cover overlapping pieces of the same auth-provider OOM class and one branch will need to become canonical before the rest are closed or rebased.

options.title: Use this combined PR
options.body: Adopt this branch as the canonical combined fix, then add or preserve focused regression coverage before closing the overlapping sibling PRs.

options.title: Use the focused siblings
options.body: Land the stronger tested focused PRs separately and close this combined branch as redundant once those fixes merge.

options.title: Ask for a consolidated replacement
options.body: Pause all overlapping branches and request a single maintained PR that combines the implementation, tests, and proof from the strongest attempts.

recommendation.title: Use this combined PR
recommendation.body: Adopt this branch as the canonical combined fix, then add or preserve focused regression coverage before closing the overlapping sibling PRs.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the current assignee and has the strongest recent history across the Google OAuth and Vertex ADC auth paths.
